description: This file contains utility functions for registering and interacting with a service worker in a Progressive Web App (PWA), including environment checks for safe registration and a method to trigger runtime cache resynchronization.

methods.name: shouldRegisterServiceWorker()
methods.description: Checks if the current environment is suitable for registering a service worker based on environment variables, security context, and browser capabilities.

methods.name: registerServiceWorker()
methods.description: Registers the service worker if environment conditions are met, returning the registration object or null on failure.

methods.name: triggerResync()
methods.description: Instructs the service worker to refresh runtime caches by posting a message, if a controller exists.
